name: 3',5'-unsubstituted… to (R)-(−)-allantoin
summary: A 9-step route from 3',5'-unsubstituted flavanone to (R)-(−)-allantoin, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: FAD synthase
reactions.equation: FMN + ATP + H(+) = FAD + diphosphate

reactions.name: xanthine phosphoribosyltransferase

reactions.name: xanthine dehydrogenase
